bio_en: Marzpet was an ARF comrade who survived the Genocide in hiding in Mesopotamia. During the war he sent the Hairenik editors a seemingly innocent love letter in German addressed to a 'Miss Sevn Bennetian', which on treatment revealed a hidden report on himself and his comrades. He wandered in disguise without finding a way to escape. News of his death in Mesopotamia reached Constantinople in 1919.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Real name not given in the portion read; article by Narkiz Kibritjian, Chakatamart 1 May 1919.
